description.value: Brownies Chicken & Seafood is a proudly Canadian fast-food restaurant with roots in the original Brownie's franchise of the late 1970s and early 1980s. The Maple Ridge location serves fried chicken sourced from Rossdown Farms in the Fraser Valley — certified Humane and Halal — alongside Ocean Wise Alaskan Cod, seafood, fresh daily salads, and classic sides. It's a well-established local favourite and one of three BC locations, making it a convenient calorie stop for cyclists passing through the Dewdney Trunk Road corridor.
